subject: [PATCH 08/60] mm/migrate: reject move_pages() destinations outside common memory

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch introduces a change to the move_pages() function to reject destinations outside common memory, aligning with existing policies for node selection and memory placement.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series aims to improve the move_pages() function by rejecting destinations outside common memory, ensuring that user memory is placed on a node chosen by the caller and adhering to general-purpose memory policies.
